text:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: hashicorp/http-echo:1.0.0
          args: ["-text=hello from api"]
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  selector:
    app: api
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 5678
label: manifests/api.yaml新しく作る

kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: hitokoto-gateway
spec:
  gatewayClassName: nginx
  listeners:
    - name: http
      protocol: HTTP
      port: 80
label: manifests/gateway.yaml新しく作る

text:
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: hitokoto
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: hitokoto-gateway
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /api
      backendRefs:
        - name: api
          port: 80
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
      backendRefs:
        - name: hitokoto
          port: 80
